question: Should ClickClack expose its existing message PATCH capability as an author-facing inline editing feature for channel messages and thread replies?
rationale: The patch adds a durable user-facing capability rather than repairing a documented UI regression, and no maintainer decision or existing product contract in the supplied discussion establishes that this surface should ship.

options.title: Sponsor message editing
options.body: Confirm the feature direction and require the contributor to fix the duplicate-editor rendering before merge.

options.title: Defer the UI surface
options.body: Keep the server API unchanged and pause or close this feature until message-editing UX is prioritized.

recommendation.title: Sponsor message editing
recommendation.body: Confirm the feature direction and require the contributor to fix the duplicate-editor rendering before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only concrete contributor connected to the proposed implementation and can address the mechanical rendering defect while a project owner supplies direction.
